pieces.name: Rockbreaker's Rig
pieces.capstone: Rich Seam: a 15% chance a cracked seam pays its ore TWICE.

pieces.name: Blacksmith's Regalia
pieces.capstone: Master Smith's Kit: +15% chance of double parts, and one extra part from every salvage.

pieces.name: Wheelwarden's Fortune
pieces.capstone: Lucky Streak: a 12% chance each spin is FREE — your spin is refunded.

pieces.name: Delver's Kit
pieces.capstone: Second Wind: the first collapse of each day leaves your haul intact.

pieces.name: Forager's Kit
pieces.capstone: Green Season: your crops grow 15% faster.

pieces.name: Founder's Regalia
pieces.capstone: Cold Crucible: an 18% chance a smelt costs you no ore at all.

pieces.name: Harvester's Garb
pieces.capstone: Bountiful Reaping: each harvest has a 20% chance to yield DOUBLE gold.

pieces.name: The Gunner's Commission
pieces.capstone: Beat to Quarters: every fight at sea opens with a Reckoning already charged — one free broadside before she answers.

pieces.name: Dread Corsair's Regalia
pieces.capstone: The Dread Pirate: +1 raid every day, raid wins pay DOUBLE gold, and a surge of Plunder & Bounty.

tracks.name: Cannons
tracks.desc: More barrels in the broadside — every gun is another roll to hit.

tracks.name: Gunnery
tracks.desc: A drilled crew lays the guns truer, and rakes more often — a ball down the length of her deck instead of into her side, for nearly double damage.

tracks.name: Hull
tracks.desc: More oak in her sides — one more plank to shoot away for every level.

tracks.name: Cunning
tracks.desc: Sea-dog nerve — a chance a raid does not use up your daily raid.

ammo.name: Chain Shot
ammo.blurb: Shreds canvas — takes a whole suit of sails at once.

ammo.name: Grapeshot
ammo.blurb: Sweeps a deck — dismounts cannons twice as fast.

locker.name: Enchantment Scroll
locker.blurb: Permanently adds an element of your choice to a piece of gear. Chest-only until now.

locker.name: Ancient Codex
locker.blurb: 2,000 XP on the spot. The only one in the game you can walk up and buy.

locker.name: Bottled Fury
locker.blurb: Triple your daily strike damage for six hours. Save it for a boss you mean to hurt.

locker.name: Elixir of Renewal
locker.blurb: Fully recharges an in-store perk you thought was spent. Real merchandise — priced like it.

locker.name: Sands of Time
locker.blurb: Use an in-store perk again today instead of waiting out its cooldown. Real merchandise.

ships.flavor: Cut down a deck for speed and still heavier than anything you have met.

ships.flavor: The reason the fleet has a name. Vane has never had to fire a second broadside.

hullGrade.name: Ironclad
hullGrade.blurb: A fortress that happens to float.

ships.flavor: Flies a flag you recognise. That is worse, not better.

hullGrade.name: Ironclad
hullGrade.blurb: A fortress that happens to float.

ships.flavor: Carries a magistrate and a rope, and has never needed the magistrate.

pieces.name: Heaven's Trident
pieces.flavor: Forged for a god of storms.

capstone.desc: The Dread Pirate: +1 raid every day, raid wins pay DOUBLE gold, and a surge of Plunder & Bounty.

legend.label: Plunder
legend.desc: A fatter purse from every raid you win — up to +50%.

legend.label: Broadside
legend.desc: Your ship's cannons hit harder in a raid.

legend.label: Ironclad
legend.desc: Your hull takes less damage from enemy volleys in a raid.

pieces.name: Brass Quadrant
pieces.flavor: Lays a gun by the angle of the deck, not the eye of the gunner.

pieces.name: Worn Rammer
pieces.flavor: The sheepskin has been replaced nine times. The staff never has.

pieces.name: Ship's Bell
pieces.flavor: Rung for the watch, for the dead, and for beating to quarters.

pieces.name: Letter of Marque
pieces.flavor: It makes the same act legal. Nothing else about it changes.

pieces.name: Powder Horn
pieces.flavor: Scratched with the names of eleven ships and one date.

pieces.name: The Black Colours
pieces.flavor: Run these up and the negotiating is finished.

tracks.name: Line
tracks.desc: Extra casts each day.

tracks.name: Lure
tracks.desc: Better odds of a rarer species.

tracks.name: Net
tracks.desc: More casts bring up treasure instead of a fish.

tracks.name: Gaff
tracks.desc: A wider bar in the reel, and land it cleanly and the fish is never a small one — size is what a catch pays.
